shots.title: Product site: home
shots.note: The public front page. It states the claim (witnesses, not warnings) before anyone logs in.

shots.title: Product site: how it works
shots.note: The pipeline in plain steps: pin, relate, build two worlds, run three times each, witness, attribute, fix.

shots.title: Product site: capabilities
shots.note: What is supported and what is not, stated openly.

shots.title: Workspace: Overview
shots.note: Counts of investigations and findings, the outcome chart, jobs by status, the Reuse and recomputation panel, the analysis funnel and what needs attention.

shots.title: New analysis
shots.note: Paste the library and the consumer. Both are pinned to exact commits before anything runs.

shots.title: Findings
shots.note: Every verdict in one list, with its mode (LIVE) and the sentence that states what was and was not shown.

shots.title: Finding detail (BREAK WITNESSED)
shots.note: The scoped verdict, what the evidence establishes, the why-path, both worlds, the dependency delta, the six runs, the scope, re-run and fix.

shots.title: Witness detail
shots.note: Three fresh passes against three fresh failures with the same signature, the six-run board and the raw output.

shots.title: Finding detail (INCONCLUSIVE)
shots.note: An unsettled result is never shown as a pass: the reasons are listed, grouped by cause.

shots.title: World matrix
shots.note: The reference world, the consumer world, and the exact delta: only the packages whose versions differ.

shots.title: Relationships
shots.note: Why two repositories are related: the file and line in both manifests at the pinned commit.

shots.title: Inventory graph
shots.note: Repositories, manifests and packages as a graph with evidence-backed edges.

shots.title: Evidence
shots.note: The bundle behind a witness: artifacts with their SHA-256, the manifest, integrity and replay.

shots.title: Jobs
shots.note: Every background job with its status, run time, wait time, failure class and attempts.

shots.title: Repositories
shots.note: The pinned snapshot of each repository and its inventory.

shots.title: Capabilities and coverage
shots.note: What this deployment can do per ecosystem, which oracles exist and which features are enabled.

shots.title: Settings
shots.note: Theme, access token and application information.

shots.title: Reuse and recomputation (the twist)
shots.note: Pairs reused, pairs recomputed, stored objects rejected, worlds reused and built, with the reason for each pair. Counted from the append-only event log.

shots.title: Analysis funnel
shots.note: Every stage as a recorded count, from submitted to verdict.
